result.reason: The clause largely reaches the preferred position for Customer assignments and change of control, and Vendor assignments remain subject to Customer consent not to be unreasonably withheld. However, it omits the required absolute prohibition on Vendor assignment to a Customer competitor. It also goes beyond the stated position by permitting Customer assignments “in whole or in part,” adding reorganisations, and barring suspension and repricing, so it is not strictly minimal. Otherwise, the language is clear and professionally drafted and preserves the original consent framework.
